title: PHLAME: A Phase-Level Hardware-in-the-Loop Framework for Reproducible Fidelity-Ladder Evaluation of TinyML Image Classifiers on ARM Cortex-M Microcontrollers
description: An open-source, reproducible framework for evaluating TinyML vision classifiers across the four-level MIL–SIL–PIL–HIL fidelity ladder on ARM Cortex-M7 microcontrollers (Arduino Portenta H7 + Vision Shield HM01B0). PHLAME couples deterministic dataset partitioning and INT8 post-training quantization with cycle-accurate DWT phase-level latency profiling (CAPTURE, PRE, INF, POST, TOTAL), on-chip FNV-1a model-identity verification, environmental condition tracking, and a camera-in-the-loop HIL bench that decomposes the simulation-to-hardware gap into quantization, on-chip execution, and optical-frontend effects.
